title: Semistable multipointed relative curves
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme and $P=(X,D)$ a multipointed $T$-curve [def-trf-multipointed-curve]. It is semistable if $D\to T$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism], each point of $D$ maps into an open of $X$ smooth over $T$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], and every nonsmooth point of each geometric fibre [def-weil-geometric-fibre] is an ordinary double point. The geometric fibre is taken over the chosen algebraic closure of each residue field, and an ordinary double point has the scalar-compatible completed local ring $\Omega[[u,v]]/(uv)$ of [def-trf-orgogozo-induction-data]. There is no connectedness, separatedness or properness assumption.

source.place: Temkin, Stable modification of relative curves, §1.2 (multipointed curves, modifications and stability); §3.1 (generic modifications)
